static_flow: main initializes features on draws[:200], calls predictions_for_round before updating features with draws[train_n], and scores actuals only after the historical prediction cache has been built. Recent slices end at train_n. The fixed seeded bank uses no observed draws.
scope: Runtime guards cover listed targets/all eight models; all record cutoffs and historical hit/structure scoring checked. This is reproducibility/leakage validation, not independent prospective performance.
